name: Suzumori Mei
source:
[b]The Little Devil Childhood Friend[/b]

"I'll make you fall in love with me for sure!"

[url=/c132879]Otonashi Sumiya[/url]'s childhood friend, she has had a crush on him since she was young. Impulsive and not very smart, sometimes when she gets too positive, she makes mistake as well, but she properly reflects and tries hard to make up for it, a troublemaker who is difficult to hate.

She likes to tease others, and is fine with being teased if it is done by someone she likes. She also likes to look up and practice seduction techniques from the Internet.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/koakuma/#character]official website[/url]]
